one_liner: Lark Open Platform offers a broad REST API with OAuth2 user tokens and app-secret tenant tokens, self-serve on any plan including free, plus an official MCP server.
auth_notes: user_access_token via OAuth authorization-code flow with refresh tokens; tenant_access_token minted from app_id and app_secret. Scopes require tenant admin approval. Tenant tokens are app-secret exchanges, classed as OTHER.
access_notes: Custom apps can be created in the Developer Console on any plan, including Starter/free. Starter has a 10,000 basic API calls/month cap. Advanced APIs need purchased quota. Scopes need admin approval.
blocker_notes: Per-tenant setup: each customer's admin must approve the app's scopes. Free plan has call quotas. Credentials are self-serve.

evidence.quote: OAuth token API for acquiring the `user_access_token` and `refresh_token`. The `user_access_token` serves as the user's access credential, which allows API calls to be made on behalf of the user.
When calling the server API, you need to include the access token in the request header `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`.
Any Lark plan, including Starter. Custom apps can call the Lark API on every plan.
The total number of basic API calls for all enterprise self-built applications under a single tenant is limited to **10,000 times per month**
plus access to 2,500+ developer APIs — without separate subscriptions.
This is the Feishu/Lark official OpenAPI MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool designed to help users quickly connect to the Feishu/Lark platform
